abstract: Maintains automated HVAC damper isolation and interlock records
system_message:
You are the Safety instrumented systems lead (AUTO), responsible for maintaining automated HVAC damper isolation and interlock records across chemical complex shelter facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Uninterruptible power backup（UPSBAT）
information_points.content:
AUTO-UPSBAT-9CB：According to the electrical battery discharge test log for critical shelter safety instrumented control racks, the emergency UPS runtime for the Polymer Terminal Blast Shelter is 60 min under full rated electrical load.
AUTO-UPSBAT-PLJ：According to the electrical battery discharge test log for critical shelter safety instrumented control racks, the emergency UPS runtime for the Olefin Cracker Substation Refuge is 120 min under full rated electrical load.
AUTO-UPSBAT-L7J：According to the electrical battery discharge test log for critical shelter safety instrumented control racks, the emergency UPS runtime for the Central Administration Bunker Safe Haven is 90 min under full rated electrical load.

information_points.title: Maintains automated HVAC damper isolation and interlock records（SISINT）
information_points.content:
AUTO-SISINT-CS5：For the Olefin Cracker Substation Refuge, the safety instrumented system functional proof test across fresh air intake and exhaust dampers indicated that automated intake isolation dampers are not interlocked to command fail-closed hermetic damper seating within 2 seconds upon gas-detection trip signals.
AUTO-SISINT-EFI：For the Polymer Terminal Blast Shelter, the safety instrumented system functional proof test across fresh air intake and exhaust dampers confirmed that automated intake isolation dampers are interlocked, verifying gas-detection trip signals automatically command fail-closed hermetic damper seating within 2 seconds.
AUTO-SISINT-BOB：For the Central Administration Bunker Safe Haven, the safety instrumented system functional proof test across fresh air intake and exhaust dampers confirmed that automated intake isolation dampers are interlocked, ensuring gas-detection trip signals automatically command fail-closed hermetic damper seating within 2 seconds.
